'''Diagnostician''' is the skill associated with the [[diagnosis]] [[labor]]. Diagnosers are responsible for deciding how a dwarf who is hurt should be treated at a [[hospital]].

Diagnostician [[skill|skill level]] is related to the speed at which the labor is completed, and it also affects the probability of identifying any active [[syndrome]]s. It is the only relevant skill of the [[chief medical dwarf]] noble position.

Diagnosers determine the freshest hell unleashed on your fortress' injured as part of the [[health care|health care industry]].  The diagnostician skill is also used by [[scholars]] when thinking about medical science-related [[topics]]:

{{DF2014:Topic/table/medicine}}
